Rouse · macOS 13+

Let your work keep going.

Keep long-running work awake, with timed sessions and independent display sleep control.

View on the App Store↗Support
Platform
macOS 13+
Version
1.13.0
Availability
App Store

Timed sessions

Keep your Mac awake indefinitely or for a focused timer, then let the session end cleanly.

Display control

Choose whether the display stays awake too, so the Mac can match the work in front of you.

Battery rules

Turn sessions off automatically below your chosen battery threshold for long practical runs.

Menu bar control

Start, stop, and check status quickly without opening a full window.

Dashboard view

Use the dashboard for richer status, presets, rules, and session details.

Official CLI

Control Rouse from Terminal, shell scripts, and local automation with rouse.

Release details

Rouse 1.13.0 is now live on the Mac App Store, with timed sessions that can let the display sleep while the Mac stays awake, plus a choice of what happens when the timer ends.
